scope: Exact CPU accumulation of frozen calibrated CFA frames and dense local pull maps; no alignment estimation or GPU fitting
identity_fields: ordered selected indices and linear qualities
chunk, neighbour and array planning limits
interpolation source and package source digests
validation: bitwise uninterrupted/resumed results across all four CFA layouts at empty, intermediate and completed checkpoints
changed source, selection, weight, raw input, map, region or execution policy refused
wrong next frame, changed raw/map and cancellation preserve all prior sums
failed or cancelled checkpoint publication preserves the previous checkpoint and removes temporary files
payload/metadata corruption, invalid count/history and oversized array headers refused
source paths, source symlinks and unrelated NPZ files protected from replacement
limits: CPU accumulation only; GPU-generated maps must be frozen and fingerprinted by the caller
No automatic re-estimation, GPU fitting/fallback or GUI integration
Checksums detect corruption, not malicious rewriting of both data and checksums
Memory guard plans arrays rather than enforcing a process RSS cap; the load path verifies headers before loading payloads
